import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_48/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_48/training_1.csv"
source2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_48/training_2.csv"
source3_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_48/training_3.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)  # ['track_id', 'dummy']
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)  # ['index_playlist', 'playlist_id']
df2 = pd.read_csv(source2_path, index_col=0)  # ['playlist_id', 'track_id', 'interaction']
df3 = pd.read_csv(source3_path, index_col=0)  # ['index_track', 'track_id']

# Operation History:
# 1) JOIN : [["Source3_48_1", "Source3_48_2"], ["playlist_id", "playlist_id"]]
# Join df1 and df2 on 'playlist_id'
df_join_1 = pd.merge(df1, df2, on="playlist_id", how="inner")

# 2) JOIN : [["Source3_48_0", "Source3_48_3"], ["track_id", "track_id"]]
# Join df0 and df3 on 'track_id'
df_join_2 = pd.merge(df0, df3, on="track_id", how="inner")

# Now join the two intermediate results on 'track_id' to combine all sources
# Because df_join_1 has 'track_id' from df2 and df_join_2 has 'track_id' from df0/df3
df_final = pd.merge(df_join_1, df_join_2, on="track_id", how="inner")

# Reorder and select columns to match target schema:
# Target Schema: ['track_id': int, 'dummy': int, 'playlist_id': int, 'interaction': int, 'index_playlist': int, 'index_track': int]

df_final = df_final[['track_id', 'dummy', 'playlist_id', 'interaction', 'index_playlist', 'index_track']]

# Ensure correct dtypes (all integer)
df_final = df_final.astype({
    'track_id': 'int64',
    'dummy': 'int64',
    'playlist_id': 'int64',
    'interaction': 'int64',
    'index_playlist': 'int64',
    'index_track': 'int64'
})

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_48/target_multisource.csv"
df_final.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
